DDL	CREATE TABLE cte_tbl USING csv AS WITH s AS (SELECT 42 AS col) SELECT * FROM s
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_tbl
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW cte_view AS WITH s AS (SELECT 42 AS col) SELECT * FROM s
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_view
WRITE	WITH s AS (SELECT 43 AS col)
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_tbl
WRITE	INSERT INTO cte_tbl WITH s AS (SELECT 44 AS col) SELECT * FROM s
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_tbl
DDL	CREATE TABLE cte_tbl2 (col INT) USING csv
PARSE_ERROR	WITH s AS (SELECT 45 AS col)
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_tbl
READ	SELECT * FROM cte_tbl2
DDL	DROP TABLE cte_tbl
DDL	DROP TABLE cte_tbl2
